latest_research_proposal.title: LLM 서비스의 Eco 명칭과 성능 양보 수용에 관한 연구계획서
latest_research_proposal.scope: LLM 서비스에서 같은 낮은 연산 옵션을 Light 대신 Eco라고 부르면, 환경적 의미의 해석과 모드 선택, 성능 양보의 수용은 어떻게 달라지는가?
latest_research_proposal.motivation: Voluntary AI-performance sacrifice for expected environmental benefit, connected through prior work to naming an effort option Eco.
latest_research_proposal.design: Proposed 1:1 randomized Light versus Eco naming comparison with identical menu descriptions and authored everyday-chat examples.
latest_research_proposal.performance_sacrifice: Separate perceived insufficiency and comparative usefulness from choosing a sufficient concise answer. No factual-error acceptance requirement.
latest_research_proposal.mode_choice_and_response_evaluation: All assigned participants evaluate shared examples after an explicit transition regardless of initial selected mode, then see the same High-labeled alternative.
latest_research_proposal.primary_outcome: Initial low-option choice in the first assigned task; proportion difference and 95% CI.
secondary_outcomes: Post-experience environmental expectations and quality assessment
Joint insufficiency report and use choice among all assigned
latest_research_proposal.sample_and_timing: Proposed 6–10 person pilot and 20–30 minute sessions pending validation; main N set from meaningful effect and precision before collection.
latest_research_proposal.sample_example: Assumed .30 versus .45 proportions, two-sided .05 alpha/.80 power yields 162.334, rounded to 163 per group. Planning illustration, not observed baseline or final approved N.
latest_research_proposal.budget: Calculate after N, session time, compensation and fees; no paid recruitment or API usage executed.
latest_research_proposal.document_QA: Latest 10 rendered pages all visually inspected; no blank/overflow pages or clipping. Source, sample arithmetic and content-scope checks completed.
latest_research_proposal.alignment_with_latest_user_intent: Rewritten following continuity concern; motivation-to-literature-to-question-to-method connection restored. User has not yet reviewed/approved the final wording or proposed task choices.
